Subject: Last-mile forecast kick: 16-min runway & final updates

Team — quick, last-mile note as we close the weekly submission window. Please read fully and action the three asks below before our 12:30 PT run. I booked a tight 16-minute alignment (link below) to confirm commits only — this is not a deal review.

Key deadlines
- Final HubSpot updates and commit flag: 1:00 PM PT today. If you need an exception, ping me before 11:30 AM PT.
- Forecast worksheet upload: use the attached forecast_submission_template.xlsx and drop to the shared Drive link.

Three asks (one-liners)
1) Stage correctness: review stage for all open Q4 QBR candidates and move any mislabeled accounts to the correct stage (Committed / Commit-Pending / Commit-Risk).
2) Commit amount: confirm net ARR number (no fluff) in HubSpot deal record and note supporting play in the comment.
3) Owner confirmation: reply on-thread with a one-line confirmation if you own the submission or tag the owner.

Call agenda (16 minutes)
- 0:00–02:00 — 1‑min status by region (US leads only)
- 02:00–08:00 — clarifying questions on 3 deals pre-flagged as late-stage risk (Ben)
- 08:00–12:00 — final commit confirmations and minor stage corrections (Grace)
- 12:00–16:00 — roll and submit, confirm HubSpot record links (Irene)

Notes: attach the template (forecast_submission_template.xlsx) and ACME deck preview for context. If an external finance contact asked for numbers, we will send a sanitized summary after submission — do not share raw sheets.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/forecast-template
Meeting: https://meet.redwood-inference.com/16min-runway (12:30 PM PT)

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Revenue Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com

Thanks all — final notes before 1:00 PM PT submission and our 12:30 PT sync (I know times overlap; please join if possible).

Grace — good question. Policy for today:
- Commit = signed contract (preferred).
- Commit-Pending = verbal + PO expected within 30 days OR signed LOE where legal has active review (mark as Commit-Pending and include expected recognition month in the HubSpot comment).

Ben — for DEAL-22841 (BrightTech) mark Commit-Pending, set expected recognition month = Jan-2027 in the HubSpot comment, and attach the short note that Procurement has an open legal review. That will satisfy ACME Finance's ask.

Irene — please coordinate the 16-minute run at 12:30 PT (I put you down to call on the bridge and confirm HubSpot links during 12:00–16:00 section).

Final checklist before 1:00 PM PT:
- Update HubSpot commit flag and numeric ARR (Ben/owners)
- Add one-line recognition month where Commit-Pending (Ben)
- Upload filled forecast template to Drive (everyone)
- Quick 16-min sync at 12:30 PT (link above)

If anyone cannot meet the 1:00 PM drop, reply with an explicit exception reason and ETA. I will collect exceptions and escalate if necessary.

See you on the runway — Mina
